title: Who may hold a role: grants rooted outside the log, held live, on replay and by the second reader
note: AUD-011 and AUD-017. Each mutation removes one enforcement point of the role registry (agent_substrate/roles.py) or one of its rules: the authority store's checks on proposing and on each transition, live and on replay; the snapshot a reader holding other grants would restore; the policy, secret and egress issuers; the governed runner's checks where each record is written and on replay; the registry's lifecycle, scope and delegation rules; and the independent reader's restatement. tests/test_role_authority.py holds each.
